take: CHI announced that Patrick Kane has been activated from injured reserve. Our numbers say he arrives into a rough situation: Chicago is 4-13-1 and creates only 42% of the quality chances (expected goals) when he's not at issue. Kane himself has 1 goal on 3.12 expected, and Chicago's share of chances at five-on-five drops by roughly 7 points with him on the ice. In his absence, Ryan Donato has played beside Nazar and Moore, and Artyom Levshunov has moved onto the first power-play unit, so those roles are now in play.
